author: More Perfect Union
description:
More Perfect University is hosting another town hall, this time with AOC and Troy Jackson.

We’re live from Portland, Maine –taking questions from students about the issues that matter most.


Students everywhere can get involved with More Perfect University and help build student power on our discord: https://discord.com/invite/QUpAyCqcr.

-----

More Perfect Union is an Emmy-winning, nonprofit newsroom whose mission is to build power for working people. Here’s what that means: We report on the real struggles and challenges of the working class from a working-class perspective. We attempt to connect those problems to potential solutions. We report on the abuses and wrongdoing of corporate power. And we seek to hold accountable the ultra-rich who have too much power over America’s political and economic systems.

 To support our independent journalism, subscribe, donate, and follow our other pages through the links below:

title: LIVE Students v. Billionaires Town Hall with AOC & Troy Jackson

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Billionaires have resorted to gaslighting Californians in an effort to defeat Prop 40, the proposed 5% tax on their wealth.

The wealth tax on billionaires is very popular, but the oligarch class has set up ballot initiatives to cancel out the wealth tax, even if it does pass.

This is what happens when the rich control the system, but the people of California have a chance to vote this November and defeat the billionaire deception.

Host: Sydney Nicole Sweeney
Editor: @discosludge
Producer: Victoria Hammett
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Billionaires are GASLIGHTING California voters

We asked why he calls Social Security a Ponzi scheme, and why Elon Musk pays a lower tax rate than you.
